name: The doors
summary: The room on the night, before the first guest walks in. The home page opens on one room at night, full width, that brightens once as if being lit; the headline crosses the photograph's lower edge onto a warm, very dark ground in one carved serif, one colour. Beneath: See your room before the day (the agency's design visuals, always labelled), the rooms, Lay the table. Eczar alone: 500 set very large against 400 at reading size in linen. Colour from the room: linen in candlelight for text, a deep panelled green for underlines and the phone bar, aged brass only in the emblem. For event designers and producers.
